coder_notes: Single-arm pilot (phase 1): partial-brain RT + TMZ + chloroquine, then TTFields + TMZ + chloroquine in newly diagnosed GBM. Chloroquine is the only investigational drug (radiation/TTF sensitiser). AMT-PET and advanced MRI are imaging endpoints only, not recorded as molecular biomarkers. TTFields is a device partner.
